title: News in brief: EFAMA sets out SFDR 2.0 priorities
lede: EIB earmarks €30 billion for climate adaptation – EFRAG seeks feedback on strategy – Most NZBA members have kept targets, study finds.

title: Two-thirds of investors believe sustainability reduces risk, survey finds
lede: Morgan Stanley poll of 900 institutional investors shows sustainability concerns falling.

title: Moscow elites pleased with US envoy Witkoff and far from agreeing to peace (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,702)
lede: Starshield, the defense version of Starlink, seems to remain slow despite US assurances that it was fully back. And journalists from Russia reveal what is being discussed by Kremlin and US officials as they seek a deal on Ukraine.

title: [Interview] Ousting Netanyahu won’t curb right-wing Israeli nationalism, says expert ahead of Tuesday’s Knesset elections
lede: Beth Oppenheim, fellow at the European Council on Foreign Relations, explains how a shift in Israeli society will shape voting on 27 October. Her analysis groups Israeli political forces into liberal Zionists, nationalists, religious nationalists, and ultra-Orthodox factions.
